---
name: commitMessage
description: Create a brief markdown commit message from provided code changes.
argument-hint: A diff or description of code modifications.
---

Review the provided code changes, or if none are provided, look at the current changes using #changes or git diff and write a concise commit message in markdown format surrounded by triple backticks. Focus on summarizing the modifications clearly and succinctly so it can be used directly as a git commit message.
